On behalf of KINRADEN, MINDWEISS is seeking a commercially minded and hands-on Finance Director to play a key role in the company’s next phase of international growth. With responsibility for strengthening financial management and developing a scalable finance function, you will have significant influence on strategic decisions and the financial foundation supporting KINRADEN’s ambitious retail expansion.

As Finance Director, you will report directly to the CEO and work closely with the wider management team, acting as a trusted financial and strategic sparring partner. You will take full ownership of the finance function, balancing strategic priorities with operational responsibilities while ensuring that financial insights actively support commercial decisions and future investments.

A central part of your responsibility will be to drive financial planning, budgeting, forecasting and performance management, ensuring reliable financial oversight and clear insights into business performance across the organisation and its growing retail operations. You will support strategic and commercial decision-making through financial analysis, business cases and scenario planning, including evaluating the financial implications of new stores, markets and investments.

Furthermore, you will be responsible for cash flow and liquidity management, financial controls and the preparation of relevant management and Board reporting, ensuring transparency and a clear overview of the company’s financial position.

You will also oversee the ongoing financial operations, including monthly closing, annual accounts, audits, tax, VAT and financial compliance. As KINRADEN continues to expand internationally, you will play a key role in developing scalable financial processes, systems and governance to support increasing business complexity and long-term growth.

Strong financial expertise and commercial understanding

To succeed in this role, you bring solid experience from a senior finance position and strong expertise in financial accounting, controlling, budgeting, forecasting and cash flow management. Your ability to combine financial expertise with commercial understanding enables you to support strategic decisions and evaluate business opportunities.

We expect you to have a relevant academic degree in finance, accounting or economics, ideally complemented by experience from an international business with multiple legal entities. A background in retail, consumer goods or luxury would be an advantage, although specific industry experience is not essential. Furthermore, you are fluent in English, have excellent Microsoft Office skills and are able to communicate financial insights clearly and effectively.

A grounded and collaborative finance leader

On a personal level, you are grounded, confident and approachable, with the professional maturity to build trust through your expertise and sound judgement. You take ownership naturally and work independently, while maintaining a collaborative and down-to-earth approach. To thrive in this role, it is essential that you are comfortable navigating changing priorities and can move seamlessly between strategic discussions and hands-on execution. Furthermore, your flexibility and pragmatic mindset enable you to contribute positively to KINRADEN’s informal and creative culture.

About KINRADEN

Founded in 2014 by Sarah Emilie Müllertz, KINRADEN is a modern luxury brand shaped by influences ranging from Japanese design traditions to Danish architecture. With a deep commitment to sustainability, the brand actively supports two of the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals: ensuring fair and dignified employment practices (Goal 8), and advocating for responsible production and consumption (Goal 12).

KINRADEN operates with a flat organizational structure and a work culture built on trust, responsibility, and a welcoming, down-to-earth atmosphere. The company embraces a distinctly Danish way of working—informal, friendly, and rooted in strong relationships. Collaboration is key, fostering a close-knit community where people support one another and value inclusivity.

Does this sound like the right opportunity for you? We would very much like to hear from you. Please apply by clicking the “Apply” button in this job posting and uploading your CV. Interviews will be held on an ongoing basis, and the position will be closed once the right candidate has been found.

We place emphasis on your competencies, qualifications, and ambitions, as well as a strong mutual fit between you and the company’s culture and values. Therefore, we encourage you not to include age, photo, nationality, or marital status in your CV. The right match is always about more than an impressive CV.

Senior Data Analyst

Alcântara, PRT, 1300‑001, | Gentofte, DNK, 2820,

Are you passionate about turning business questions into meaningful data solutions? Do you enjoy working with stakeholders, solving complex data challenges, and transforming data into insights that drive better decisions? Then you might be the person we are looking for.

As our new Senior Data Analyst, you will join the Data & Insights team and report directly to the Head of Data & Insights. • 5+ years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst, or similar data-facing role, ideally in a retail or consumer business.

• Strong SQL skills — comfortable writing and troubleshooting complex queries independently.

• Familiarity with SAP data structures, particularly FI (Finance) and SD (Sales & Distribution).

• Experience with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), or willingness to learn it, is a plus.

• Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Business, Economics, Finance, Data/Statistics, Engineering, or related).

• Proven experience gathering requirements from business stakeholders and translating them into technical/data specifications.

• Strong stakeholder management skills — able to align multiple stakeholders (including Finance, Sales, Supply Chain, and IT/data engineering) with sometimes competing priorities, and communicate trade-offs clearly.

• Comfortable operating with a degree of ambiguity and turning it into a structured plan.

Are you an experienced SEO specialist with strong technical, content and analytical skills, and a curiosity for how AI is reshaping search?

Working closely with the SEO Director and wider team, you will contribute to client strategy while remaining hands-on with delivery. You will work across technical SEO, content strategy and performance analysis, translating data and insights into clear recommendations and action plans. You will also help clients understand how AI-driven search and Large Language Models are changing discovery and content requirements.

**

Please note that relocation assistance is not available for this position, and applicants should have the legal right to live and work in Denmark.

You will collaborate with specialists across media, data, technology, content and marketing, while benefiting from access to Omnicom's global network of more than 4,000 specialists.

What matters most is that you bring strong SEO expertise, strategic thinking, curiosity, collaboration and the drive to keep developing your craft. If you have any questions about the role, please feel free to contact our SEO Director, Rebecca Booth (rebecca.booth@omc.com).

Do you enjoy developing people and creating structure in a busy microbiology environment?

Join Bavarian Nordic as a QC Manager and help your team deliver reliable analyses that support the production and supply of vaccines that protect lives.

**The Microbiology area consists of eight laboratory technicians and seven scientists organised across two teams. The area performs analytical testing of raw materials, intermediates, finished products, environmental samples and other manufacturing-related samples. Methods include bioburden, TOC, endotoxin, identification using MALDI-TOF and sterility testing.

The laboratory operates seven days a week during daytime hours because certain analyses are time critical. The teams work in a shift rotation covering weekends and public holidays.

You will join a QC department of approximately 90 employees across six teams. Our Core Leadership Team of Senior Managers works closely with First-Line Managers, the Operational Excellence Partner and a Quality Integrator to develop people and processes and maintain strong quality oversight.

QC is undergoing significant change as we support increased production demands, improve efficiency and reduce lead times. As a first-line manager, you will translate changing priorities into clear direction while maintaining employee engagement, well-being and a strong quality mindset.

**Your Responsibilities

**Lead and develop your team. Set clear expectations, provide regular feedback and coach employees in their professional development. Build competencies and a supportive working environment where people feel confident raising concerns and take responsibility for quality.

Ensure reliable daily operations. Maintain an overview of workload, sample flow and operational risks. Coordinate priorities and resources to support time-critical analyses and continuity across the laboratory’s seven-day operation.

Maintain quality and improve processes. Ensure activities comply with cGMP and the Bavarian Nordic Quality Management System. Promote data integrity and inspection readiness and improve processes across the sample lifecycle through accurate documentation and reliable sample flow.

Collaborate across QC and manufacturing. Work closely with stakeholders to align testing priorities with manufacturing needs. Use data and digital tools to improve transparency, address bottlenecks and reduce lead times while maintaining quality.

**Your profile

**You combine an understanding of microbiological quality control with a practical, people-focused leadership approach. You remain clear and approachable when priorities change and can balance timely delivery with compliance and employee well-being.

• A relevant scientific degree and experience from a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical or biotechnology environment, preferably within QC microbiology.

• An understanding of microbiological testing and its role in supporting manufacturing and product quality.

• Leadership experience from QC, a laboratory or a similar operational area, is an advantage, together with the ability to coach others and build engagement.

• A solid understanding of cGMP, data integrity and Quality Management Systems, and confidence working with LIMS or other digital laboratory tools.

• A structured approach to prioritization and continuous improvement, with clear communication and strong cross-functional collaboration skills.

**Why join Bavarian Nordic

**You will lead a team whose work supports the quality of vaccines supplied to people around the world. The role offers the opportunity to strengthen daily operations, develop employees and influence how Microbiology collaborates with the wider organisation.

You will be part of a leadership team that values collaboration, coaching and building strong competencies. As QC evolves, you can contribute to continuous improvement, digitalisation and Operational Excellence while developing professionally in an international vaccine company.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

**Improving and saving lives through innovative vaccines is at the heart of what we do at Bavarian Nordic. We are a fully integrated vaccine company focused on the development, manufacturing and commercialisation of life-saving vaccines, and the largest pure-play vaccine company in the world.

_Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. Solar panels make plenty of power in summer and very little in winter, when we need it most. Photoncycle solves that for households. We store energy from the summer sun, so that the it can be used all winter. When there’s excess energy, we sell the surplus to the grid, where it helps balance supply and demand. Households pay a fixed monthly fee; we build, install and operate the system.

Our mission is to accelerate the transition to a more renewable, balanced, and secure energy system. Photoncycle systems enable households to use homegrown energy year-round for electricity, heat, and hot water, while also helping the grid balance production and consumption peaks. This enables the transition away from fossil-based energy.

For our Product Cybersecurity department, we are looking for an experienced, highly skilled and motivated Product Cybersecurity Architect to drive the definition and implementation of solution-wide security across exciting industrial product ranges. In this role, you will provide cybersecurity architecture expertise across multiple product and engineering domains, contribute to the development of cybersecurity standards and architectural principles, and work closely with development teams to strengthen the security and resilience of our products and solutions.

You will be part of Product Cybersecurity department, an international team of cybersecurity professionals united by a shared mission: enabling secure digitalization and ensuring that cybersecurity is built into products and solutions by design.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Define and maintain overall cybersecurity architectural framework for products and solutions

• Establish and maintain cybersecurity principles, standards, guardrails, reference architectures, and secure development practices aligned with industry standards.

• Translate business, regulatory, and customer requirements into secure and scalable architectural solutions.

• Drive the adoption of Secure-by-Design principles and practices across products, solutions, and engineering processes.

• Facilitate cybersecurity architecture and design reviews, ensuring alignment with secure-by-design principles and organizational security objectives.

• Provide cybersecurity guidance on design and implementation to product development teams.

• Perform threat modeling and risk assessments at component, system, and solution levels.

• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to integrate cybersecurity requirements into product roadmaps, development processes, and engineering practices.

• Provide cybersecurity expertise and advisory support throughout customer projects, from proposal and design phases through implementation and delivery.

• Support cybersecurity certification, compliance, and assessment activities, including alignment with ISA/IEC 62443, Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), NIS2, and other applicable requirements.

• An academic degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a comparable field.

• Several years of experience in cybersecurity, product security, or OT cybersecurity in an architect, lead specialist, or similar role.

• Excellent technical security knowledge based on cybersecurity standards and good practices.

• Experience with widely recognized OT cybersecurity standards, including ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, and ISO 27001.

• Experience with threat modeling, risk assessment, and security architecture reviews.

• Experience with SCADA systems, Industrial Control Systems (ICS), and industrial communication networks.

• Knowledge of containerization and container orchestration security.

• Knowledge of cloud security principles and architecture.

• Understanding of AI-driven cybersecurity, including the use of AI in both offensive and defensive security contexts, and its implications for product security, threat detection, and secure system architecture.

• Fluency in English. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and communicate technical information to non-technical stakeholders

• Proven ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

You are an ideal candidate, if you have:

• Relevant cybersecurity certifications such as CISSP, CSSLP, CCSP, or ISA/IEC 62443 Cybersecurity Expert.

• Knowledge of security and enterprise architecture frameworks such as SABSA and TOGAF.

• Experience with regulatory and compliance requirements relevant to OT and connected products, including NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), and NERC CIP.

About Envira

Envira turns satellite and geospatial data into climate-risk intelligence for banks, insurers and public authorities. Envira Flood covers flood and storm-surge risk at building level; Envira Agro covers crop and climate risk across agricultural portfolios. We're based in Copenhagen and won the EU Big Data from Space Award 2025 plus the Danish Grunddataprisen 2026.

The role

Full-time, on-site in Copenhagen five days a week. You'll own the platforms our customers use, working closely with our data scientists and leadership, with real influence on how our products are built and run. This isn't a standard corporate job: we're looking for people who ship and want to grow fast. There will be pressure, and real ownership to match.

• Building and extending our web platforms and APIs

• Connecting our geospatial data and risk models to customer-facing applications

• Running and improving our Azure infrastructure: deployment, monitoring and reliability

• Data security and access control, in line with what financial-sector customers expect

Python and FastAPI · React and TypeScript · Postgres · Azure · Docker

• Newly graduated or up to 3–4 years of experience, with a degree in computer science, engineering or similar

• You've built something, run it in production yourself, and kept it running

• You use AI tools daily, and review, question and discard what they produce when it's wrong

• Free lunch at the office

• Ownership of real products used by banks, insurers and public authorities

• The opportunity for tremendous growth

Our process

Short screening call → two-hour practical task on realistic data with your usual AI tools (no whiteboard puzzles) → interview where you walk us through your solution and meet the team.

How to apply

Please apply through our application form (about 10 minutes; we ask for your CV, grades, GitHub link and salary expectation). We review applications on a rolling basis, so apply early.

PanTarg is a Danish biotechnology company developing novel anti-cancer therapies in the form of antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) for the treatment of aggressive cancers with high unmet medical need.

Our work is based on more than 30 years of research conducted at Rigshospitalet and University of Copenhagen, and our vision is to enable novel treatment options for cancer patients via a novel first-in-class approach to targeted therapy.

We are currently incubated at the BioInnovation Institute (BII), a Copenhagen-based incubation hub for biotech startups in Europe. Here, we are currently progressing through preclinical development, aiming to reach a stage of clinical testing within a few years.

The position

We are looking for a scientist to join our team on site at BII. We are primarily looking for a candidate with several years of hands-on experience, especially within immunohistochemistry (IHC) techniques and target expression analyses. The candidate will be responsible for generating and analyzing data that will be essential for several key readouts and business decisions, including safety assessments and clinical indication selection.

Qualifications

• 
Primary qualification: Documented experience in histology and IHC, including target/biomarker scoring, tissue microarrays (TMA), and spatial analysis. Experience with tissue handling, sectioning, and staining is highly desirable, ideally combined with experience using digital image-analysis software such as QuPath or equivalent.

• 
The optimal candidate will have obtained a PhD degree and have at least 3-5 years of experience from either pharma, biotech, or as a post doc. Robust and documented (5+ years) relevant hands-on experience without a PhD degree may also be acceptable, if the primary qualification is met.

• 
Secondary qualification: Hands-on experience with in vitro biology & pharmacology in the form of mammalian cell culture, in vitro dose-response studies and characterization of drug activity, cell viability/cytotoxicity assays, flow cytometry, ELISA, and related cellular assays, will be a highly desired skillset.

• 
Good scientific communications skills, and the ability to clearly and precisely present data to a professional audience.

• 
Good interpersonal skills, and the ability to thrive in a startup environment where flexibility and a can-do attitude is part of everyday work life.

• 
Fluent in the English language, written as well as spoken.

General information and how to apply

• 
You will be reporting to the Chief Scientific Officer.

• 
The position is full time, and on-site presence at the BioInnovation Institute in Copenhagen will be required.

• 
Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, and the selected candidate will start as soon as possible.

• 
Application takes place via the application system here at LinkedIn.

Please provide and combine, in a single file for the LinkedIn application system, a one-page CV, as well as a short, motivated application letter (also one page), summarizing your relevant experience, key responsibilities in previous roles, and motivation for applying for the position.
